name: Lilamon
main_effect:
When this card would be played from the hand, if you have [Yuuko Kamishiro] or a [CS] trait Digimon, reduce the play cost by 3.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] By suspending 1 Digimon, until your opponent's turn ends, their effects can't return 1 of your Digimon with [Vegetation], [Plant] or [Fairy] in any of its traits or the [CS] trait to hands or decks.
source_effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle, trash their top security card.
